messages:
Samir K.: Heads-up: noticed a 3.5% card surcharge on my Hertz rental last night at SFO. Total hit was $27.30 on a $780 bill. Booking REF: HZ-9987. Can finance get this reversed to the corporate card?

Maria R.: @Samir K. thanks — please attach the receipt and the statement line in Expensify. If it's explicitly labeled as a 'card surcharge' the vendor shouldn't add it per our policy.

Samir K.: Uploaded receipt and statement. Receipt shows:
```
Hertz Rent A Car
Res HZ-9987
Base: $780.00
Card surcharge (3.5%): $27.30
Grand total: $807.30
```
Link: https://expensify.example/receipt/hz9987

Finance Bot: Auto-flag: merchant_card_surcharge. Assigning to finance ops queue. See policy: https://go.redwood/finance/surcharges

Maria R.: Okay. @Jordan P. can you approve outreach to Hertz for a reversal? If they refuse, we'll reimburse now and open recovery process.

Jordan P.: Approve. Go ahead. :white_check_mark:

Maria R.: Plan: (1) contact vendor billing with receipt and policy citation; (2) allow 7 business days for reversal; (3) if no reversal, we will reimburse Samir and create AP recovery ticket to recoup from vendor later. Samir, do you prefer vendor-first or immediate reimbursement so you're not out of pocket?

Samir K.: Vendor-first works. If they deny, reimburse and I'll sign any forms necessary. Thanks.

Expensify Bot: Report 2024-11-09-501 updated: tag=merchant_surcharge, status=pending_vendor_response, assigned=Maria R.

Maria R.: Emailed billing@hertz.com with booking ref and expense PDF. CCed contracts. Ticket created: FIN-REB-4472. ETA vendor reply: ~5 business days. Will update thread when we hear back. :envelope_with_arrow:

Samir K.: Appreciate it :thumbsup:
_metadata_note: Short finance Slack thread about a corporate card merchant surcharge on a car rental; includes bot annotations and clear next steps.
